title: Plan graph (plan.yaml)
description: Machine-readable, immutable structure of a plan emitted by mplan: waves, stories, dependencies, and per-story validation. Lives at context/project/plans/<plan-id>/plan.yaml, alongside the human-readable PLAN-*.md story files and the mutable state.yaml. mexecute reads this instead of re-deriving structure from prose.

plan_id.description: <NNN>-<slug>, matching the plan directory name, e.g. 003-adapter-retry-logic or 000-initial.

project_change.description: The PROJECT-CHANGE <NNN> this plan implements; null for a full/greenfield plan. Quote the value in YAML — an unquoted digit run resolves as a number (e.g. 010 becomes the integer 8 under YAML 1.1's octal branch), which fails the string type.

repos.description: Every repo this plan touches (one story targets exactly one repo).

storyId.description: {WW}-{SS}[m]-{REPO}-{MODULE}, matching the PLAN-*.md filename minus the PLAN- prefix and .md suffix.

kind.description: exit-code steps are runnable commands (preferred); prose steps are agent-interpreted.

command.description: Required when kind is exit-code: a shell command run relative to repos/<repo>/ that must exit 0.

prerequisites.description: Story ids from earlier waves that must be applied first. Empty for wave 1.

parallel_group.description: Same-wave sibling stories that run concurrently. Module-disjoint by construction.

change_file.description: Incremental plans: the repo-level change file this story implements. null for full/greenfield.

target_paths.description: Source paths (relative to repos/<repo>/) this story writes — used to confirm module-disjointness.
